data.title: Eli Lilly's GLP-1 Pill Wins Key European Backing for Obesity and Diabetes
data.description: Eli Lilly gains positive CHMP opinion for Foundayo (orforglipron), a new oral GLP-1 tablet for weight loss and type 2 diabetes.

data.title: Nvidia, Micron and Broadcom Already Trade Like Cisco Post Dot-Com Burst: Bank of America
data.description: Bank of America’s Vivek Arya says Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron trade near 13x forward earnings, in line with Cisco after the dot-com crash.

data.title: UCB Scores FDA Win With First-Of-Its-Kind Daily Autoinjector for Rare Muscle Disorder
